intro: At Maclure Vineyards, Billy Maclure's pranks stir trouble between two neighboring farms. The young human boy dodges chores and plays at the feud between his family and the Stonefields, but fresh pastries can win his cooperation.

p: Billy Maclure spends his days outside the barn at Maclure Vineyards, near farmer Gerard Tiller. He grows up among the grapevines in southern Elwynn Forest, often dodging chores and roaming the meadows. The Maclures and Stonefields have long been hostile toward each other. Billy treats their feud as a chance for pranks and petty theft.
